summary: Binance (Binance Holdings Limited) is adjudged ADVERSE with 98% confidence. The decisive adverse facts are its November 2023 guilty plea to US criminal charges (≈$4.3 billion) and the SEC’s June 2023 civil lawsuit, both constituting material adverse findings as of 2026‑09‑30.

findings.statement: The full legal name of Binance is Binance Holdings Limited.
Binance Holdings Limited pleaded guilty to US criminal charges in November 2023, agreeing to pay approximately $4.3 billion.
The SEC filed a civil lawsuit against Binance Holdings Limited on June 5, 2023, constituting a major regulator enforcement action.
